name: Kurosawa Karen
source: She is a junior from your previous part-time work at a cafe. Once she has made up her mind, she will definitely put it into action and no one is stopping her. She is the type that gets along very well with other people and has a lot of connections. She likes you and proactively approaches you with some subtleness.
